text:
Predicates:
ProfessionalBasketballPlayer(x) ::: x is a professional basketball player.
AmericanNational(x) ::: x is an American national.
CanDoJumpShots(x) ::: x can do jump shots.
LeapsStraightIntoAir(x) ::: x leaps straight into the air.
ActivatesLegMuscles(x) ::: x activates their leg muscles.
Yuri ::: refers to Yuri.

Premises:
∃x (ProfessionalBasketballPlayer(x) ∧ ¬AmericanNational(x)) ::: Some professional basketball players are not American nationals.
∀x (ProfessionalBasketballPlayer(x) → CanDoJumpShots(x)) ::: All professional basketball players can do jump shots.
∀x (CanDoJumpShots(x) → LeapsStraightIntoAir(x)) ::: If someone can do jump shots, they leap straight into the air.
∀x (LeapsStraightIntoAir(x) → ActivatesLegMuscles(x)) ::: If someone leaps straight into the air, they activate their leg muscles.
¬ActivatesLegMuscles(Yuri) ::: Yuri does not activate his leg muscles.

Conclusion:
If ¬LeapsStraightIntoAir(Yuri), then AmericanNational(Yuri) ::: If Yuri does not leap straight into the air, then Yuri is an American professional basketball player.
